name: Heavy Autocannon
description: Heavy autocannons bridge the gap between fast-firing autocannons and high-caliber cannons. Autocannons require electric power to load ammo from connected belts or drums.

logicNodes.label: Trigger
logicNodes.description: When true: feeds, loads, and fires cartridges from a connected belt or drum.

logicNodes.label: Loaded
logicNodes.description: Returns true when a cartridge is loaded and ready to fire.

logicNodes.label: Fuse Timer
logicNodes.description: Sets the optional time-delay fuse in seconds for high-explosive and fragmentation ammo types.
